evidence: Inspected decompiled/main/main_0100.c:46343-46379 and callers at main_0085.c:36709-36712, main_0130.c:13016-13019, and main_0130.c:13023-13026. The body tests byte [object+0x428], resolves a status-dependent 3-bit value, and compares it with a mode-derived value to return a boolean; exact higher-level meaning is not established.

Inspected decompiled/main/main_0093.c:50077-50146 and callers at main_0104.c:53757-53761 and main_0106.c:2541-2545. The body checks status codes and object fields, retrieves a player attribute float, and returns a bounded integer or -2 sentinel; the meaning of its status/attribute combination is not established.

Inspected decompiled/main/main_0158.c:10068-10143. For the selected-state path it iterates sample records, calls pitch_flight_append_sample_record (main_0158.c:10125), then pitch_flight_integrate_selected_state (main_0158.c:10128), continuing while the state remains active (main_0158.c:10130-10134). Caller main_0158.c:23273-23277 sets up the vector state and invokes this routine.

Inspected decompiled/main/main_0032.c:29183-29280. The routine checks an attribute context status, iterates up to eight nested attribute slots, fetches each slot with nested_attribute_block_get_float (main_0032.c:29268-29270), and calls nested_attribute_delta_add for selected entries (main_0032.c:29247-29257). Caller main_0032.c:27727-27730 passes the context, block, and selector arguments.

Inspected decompiled/main/main_0111.c:12154-12206. It clears byte/word state at offsets 0x257, 0x24d, 0x250, and 0x254, conditionally derives values for offsets 0x24c and 0x256, calls aggregate_related_attribute_values (line 12192), then populates the nested player attribute block (line 12200). Caller main_0111.c:11777-11780 invokes it when the block state byte at +0x24d is set.
